description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Range 30 feet

Formally call out one creature that can hear and understand you. It must attempt a Will save against your Class DC. On a failure it is compelled to treat you as its only worthwhile opponent for 1 minute, taking a −2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against anyone else; on a critical failure it also cannot willingly move further from you. It may attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns in which you have not attacked it.
